prompt.generated_prompt_string: A medium-close vertical luxury lifestyle editorial photograph of an adult East Asian woman with soft yet defined features, warm natural skin, long voluminous chocolate-brown waves parted at the center, natural peach makeup, and a calm direct gaze. She is seated on a bed, leaning slightly back on one arm, wearing a white crochet halter top with a modestly lined interior, delicate open-knit texture, and a center drawstring tie, plus a small circular silver or white-gold pendant resting at her collarbone. White linens are softly rumpled around her; behind her is a beige wall with two minimalist framed artworks softly blurred for depth. Use large diffused window light through a sheer curtain at approximately 4300K for even facial illumination and gentle shadows. Preserve visible natural skin texture, slight under-eye variation, and a quiet, cozy afternoon-at-home mood. Canon EOS R5, 85mm f/1.8, shallow depth of field, subtly desaturated warm-neutral color treatment.
